description: Upload an image or video to Social0 and get a media ID for posts. For remote AI hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT), pass url (public direct file URL) or data (base64). file_path only works when the MCP server can read that path on its own machine.

data.description: Base64 file bytes or a data: URL (data:image/png;base64,...).

file_path.description: Local path on the MCP server machine. Do not use for remote sandboxes.

filename.description: Filename with extension (required for bare base64 data; optional for url).

mime_type.description: MIME type if not clear from filename/url (e.g. image/png).

url.description: Public http(s) URL to download. Must be a direct file link the server can fetch.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

name: upload_media
title: Upload media
